about: The host check's references (llm_mini_infer/hostcheck.py), measured by the check itself. `host`: the host measures' values and ranges, from the hosts it names, for any host. `loads`: loads in a reference.json's format (`load_reference`), each labelled by its GPU, power class, model, drafter and workload: a run gets verdicts against an entry only when every label is the run's. An entry's workload labels say which synthetic workload it was measured on (its version) and with which flags. The entry below is a default run of 0.8.0 (the model flags only; batch invariance off, that release's default at the model's context) on its GPU, model and drafter, on an AMD EPYC Zen 5 host (the `host` values come from the hosts `hosts` names).

host.hosts: x86-64 server hosts (AMD EPYC, Zen 3 and Zen 4) with RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell cards
python_loop_s: cpubench 0.22-0.27 s on normal hosts (slow hosts: 0.4+)

loads.card: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition, 600 W
loads.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition
